key_insight: Deriving stochastic thin-film equations directly from N-particle Hamiltonian dynamics reveals microscopic noise contributions for two-layer and evaporating films.
engineering_relevance: The framework could improve nanoscale coating and evaporating-film models where thermal fluctuations and coupled interfaces matter.
method: Start from exact microscopic N-particle Hamiltonian dynamics.
Coarse-grain using generalized fluctuating dynamic density-functional theory.
Extend the derivation to two-layer interfaces and non-conserved evaporation dynamics.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical derivations of new stochastic equations but provides no numerical benchmarks or experimental validation.
watch_item: Practical accuracy and computational cost for specific materials and evaporation conditions remain to be established.
paper_title: Microscopic Derivation of Stochastic Thin-Film Equation and Extensions to Two-Layer and Evaporating Films
